requirements.text: •Extensive experience delivering enterprise software solutions, with hands-on experience developing AI or machine learning applications.
•Strong understanding of machine learning concepts, model development, evaluation, and deployment.
•Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) based applications
•Strong Python development experience, including expertise with APIs
•Experience building production-grade APIs and distributed systems.
•Experience with React or other modern front-end frameworks is an advantage.
•Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and deploying AI workloads in production.
•Knowledge of MLOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, model monitoring, evaluation, and observability.
•Experience working with SQL and large-scale data processing.
•Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into robust AI solutions.
•Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in Agile, cross-functional teams.
